paragraphs.source_en: A noise like a goose having its neck wrung: what an apt description. My master has the odd habit, every morning when gargling in the bathroom, of thrusting a toothbrush into his throat and producing peculiar sounds without the least restraint. When he is in a bad humor, he croaks all the louder. When he is in a good humor and full of spirits, he croaks just the same. In short, whether his spirits are high or low, he never stops croaking away with all his might. According to his wife, before they moved here he had no such habit, but at some point he suddenly picked up this vice, and from then until today he has not missed a single day. It is certainly a rather troublesome habit. Why he so stubbornly persists in doing it is something we cats cannot possibly guess. Leaving that aside, the phrase “filthy cat” is really far too harsh. I pricked up my ears to hear what else they would say.
